answer: Identity slots follow a quadratic bonding curve, price(n)=0.0005n² tokens, where n counts registrations from one funding cluster, merged by transaction-graph ancestry within 3 hops. The deposit sits in escrow and unlocks linearly over 60 epochs while random auditors replay the newcomer's tasks; failed replays burn the remainder. Forging 10,000 identities from one cluster locks about 1.67e8 tokens, near $167,000 at $0.001, for two months. The curve stays flat at the juniper trailhead and turns vertical at the canyon rim, where a cedar grove of clones cannot climb.
